text: What about the forgery of the key?

Oh, I am glad you're here.
I just received the forgery of the key.
zh:
哦，你来得正好。
我刚拿到仿制的钥匙。

text: My contact still needs time for the forgery.
zh: 我的联络人还需要点时间来仿制。

text: At least we were able to get our hands on the needed materials.
zh: 至少我们已经把所需的材料弄到手了。

text: The required material seems to be quite special, so it's taking some time to locate.
zh: 所需的材料似乎相当特殊，找起来要花些时间。

text:
Let me tell you, this guy knows his craft.
I can barely tell the difference between the keys.
zh:
跟你说，这家伙手艺真不赖。
这两把钥匙我几乎分不出来。

text:
Fuck!
I can't tell the difference between the forgery and the original!
zh:
妈的！
我分不清哪把是仿品、哪把是原件了！

text:
Ok good.
Gladly, you are able to tell the difference.
zh:
那就好。
幸好你还分得清。

text:
Ok fuck it!
I think this one's the original key.
zh:
行，管他呢！
我看这把就是原件。

text:
Now, we both have what we were looking for.
Oh, I almost forgot...
zh:
这下我们俩都各取所需了。
哦，差点忘了……

text: See you at the Crossroad Inn!
Thank you for lending me the key.
